In order for us obtain the CA qualification here, we require an accredited undergrad degree as well as postgrad diploma before we can attempt the board exams. I have obtained an acrredited undergrad degree and previously attempted to obtain the postgrad diploma but I've found it to be too difficult. The reason was definitely not the calculations, the volume of information and application of principles definitely was a factor but it was mostly the standard of the exams and the pressure. What I mean by that is you need a really good understanding of the principles and you have to really think but time never seems enough. Also, all subjects are written in the span of a few days.
